verdict.rationale: Termius is a terminal/SSH client with a documented built-in Local terminal, so installing Python packages locally on the device is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence mentions a bundled Python runtime or on-device pip installs. The only mention of packages is that autocomplete needs no third-party packages, which is unrelated.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install additional pure-Python packages using pip directly on my device
